title: 狗为什么一路闻过去
subtitle: 它用鼻子看世界
character: wearing a sky blue t-shirt, sand coloured shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft pastel drawing with powdery blended strokes and grainy texture, dusty blue, warm sand and soft green

pages.zh:
我牵着狗去散步。
它一路都低着头，
这儿停下闻一闻，
那儿又停下闻闻，
走得比我还要慢。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up standing on a grass path holding a dog's lead, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, patient; beside him one dog has its nose down in the grass. No other person in the picture.

pages.zh:
我们鼻子里
有五百万个闻味的细胞。
狗有整整两亿多个。
一个一个数过去，
差了好几十倍。

它的鼻子里面
并不是空空的，
是一层层薄薄的皱褶。
要是摊平铺开来，
比一张手帕还大。
pages.scene: A cut-away side view of a dog's head on a cream background, showing many thin folded layers of tissue filling the whole space inside its nose. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
它还有一个本事：
左边鼻孔和右边鼻孔，
是分开来闻的。
两边闻到的浓淡
常常不一样。

哪边先闻到，
哪边的味道更浓，
它就往哪边转过去。
气味是从哪里来的，
它一下就找准了。
pages.scene: One single dog standing in grass on a cream background with its head turned to one side and its nose lifted, thin drifting lines of scent coming towards it from the left. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
吸气从鼻孔前面进，
呼气从两边缝里出。
这样吹出去的风
不会把眼前的味道
吹散掉一点。

它低头闻的地方，
刚才有别的狗来过。
是大狗还是小狗，
心情好还是不好，
味里全写着呢。
pages.scene: One single dog with its nose pressed to the ground beside a wooden lamp post on a cream background, sniffing hard. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
一根电线杆上面，
常留着好几只狗
写下来的消息。
一只压着一只，
像一面贴满纸条的墙。

它的鼻头总是湿的。
湿了才粘得住
飘在空气里的味道。
刚睡醒的时候
才会干上一会儿。
pages.scene: Close view of one single dog's nose on a cream background, the black nose tip shiny and wet. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
昨天有只野猫
从这儿走过去。
味道已经淡了，
可它还闻得出来，
还知道猫是往哪边走的。

有的狗在机场上班，
有的跟着人进山里，
去找走丢的孩子。
我们看不见的东西，
它能闻得见。
pages.scene: One single dog wearing a working harness walking through tall grass on a cream background, its nose down and its tail straight out behind it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我也蹲下去闻了闻，
草就是草的味儿。
它抬起头来看看我，
好像在说一句：
你什么都没读到吧。
pages.scene: A medium shot of the little boy seen from his knees up crouching down with his own nose close to the grass, his face turned towards the viewer, drawn with the natural body proportions of a real five-year-old child, his head in proportion to his body and about one fifth of his height, not a big-headed cartoon, his eyes calm and natural, puzzled; one dog sits beside him watching. No other person in the picture.
